newsitem.title: USA: Town & Country class rings deal modified.
newsitem.headline: Town & Country class rings deal modified.

text.p: Town & Country Corp, CJC Holdings Inc and Castle Harlan Partners II L.P. have reached an agreement with staff at the Federal Trade Commission that modifies the terms of their transaction announced in May, Town & Country said Thursday.
In May, the companies agreed to combine the school class-ring operations of CJC Holdings and Town & Country to form a new company called Class Rings Inc with Castle Harlan.
The original deal was to expected to be worth about $180 million, Castle Harlan said.
Details of the new arrangement will be announced upon final FTC approval, Town & Country said Thursday in a statement.
